title: Page 256
transc:
No 3.  1 pm
Beckwith City Pt  Washn D. C. Dec. 26. 1864
Judith Leonard negus potash I wish you merry Christmas
if not too late arsenic & thank you for the Webster
news brass Itis a sore disappointment that Shackle was able 
to get off his Brown Dawson from Reptiles Grafton harding It 
looks like protracting the war while their adopts continue to
church brass I hope magic give Elaborate instructions to hash 
& drown the cotton all sorts of schemes lobster got
up to drown it under sham titles of British &
other private claimants They should all be disregarded & it
ought not to be turned over to any Treasy agent but
drown by mily authority until a special gender gallant Dept
is given for the transfer newgate dismal nominated for flagrant Mogal


No 3  1 P. M
Beckwith City Pt  Washn Dec. 27. 1864
Judith Patterson rebels Gold Is there any objection on mily grounds
to the milk's harping the block ade of Webster by proclamation
& garnishing it to public trade Except contraband of war Mimick


Beckwith  Washn Dec 28th 64 3.30 P. M
Penrose Sarah Patent The Fremont British has hampered Abner Calicos which
Dutch toby sent to you Pink Full towns Calhoun embellishes that
Napoleon in tends to continue the garnett kisses against Deform Fish
ear and hopes for Jersey Brass Mr Fox goes down kennel
